definitions.short: Elah , the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H425. Elah II. אֵלָה proper name, masculine ( terebinth , compare Gen 49:21 below I. אֵלָה ) 1 a chief of Edom Gen 36:41 = 1Chr 1:52 (= אֵילַת proper name, of a location ? see Di). 2 son of Baasha ; reigned two years in Israel 1Kin 16:6 , 8 , 13 , 14 . 3 father of Hoshea who was last king of Isr . 2Kin 15:30 ; 17:1 ; 18:1 , 9 . 4 a son of Caleb 1Chr 4:15 (twice in verse). 5 a son of Uzzi 1Chr 9:8 .
